subject: 2025 Disability Fair Planning
overview: The Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities met to plan the upcoming May 10th Disability Fair, receive updates on City Hall accessibility upgrades, and discuss local transit accessibility.

items.title: Welcome and Introductions
items.summary: Commission members, city staff, and local residents introduced themselves and shared their personal and professional backgrounds in disability advocacy.

items.title: Disability Fair Update
items.summary: The Commission scheduled the next Disability Fair for May 10, 2025, and discussed potential vendors, sensory quiet spaces, promotional outreach, and featuring disabled speakers and artists.

items.title: City Hall Accessibility Updates
items.summary: Nwajei reported that ARPA funds were used to upgrade hearing accessibility and add cushioned armchairs to the City Hall chambers, and noted that fully accessible bathroom renovations are in the design phase.

items.title: Transportation Accessibility and Keolis Update
items.summary: The Commission discussed the planned March 10th opening of the accessible ramp at West Medford train station, while sharing concerns regarding local sidewalk conditions and "The Ride" transit services.

items.title: General Commission Updates and Announcements
items.summary: Nwajei shared details on upcoming Community Access Monitor training sessions, state-level personnel changes, and confirmed that ASL interpreters will be secured for the upcoming Disability Fair.
